about: Budgets for scripts/perf-measure.sh, compared by scripts/perf-budget.py in the Performance budget job (#853). Every metric is lower-is-better. baseline is the number a budget was set from; budget is the most a pull request may measure. Raising a budget is a reviewed change: say why in the pull request. arm64 baselines come from one local run on Docker Desktop (arm64). Image sizes get 10%. Startup and memory vary between machines, so their budgets sit at about two and a half times and one and a half times the number seen. amd64 has a baseline of null and no budget yet: the job records its numbers (the perf-amd64 artifact) until a run on a GitHub runner gives a baseline to set it from. Sizes are MB, startup is seconds until the server answers 200 for a built static file (not a page render, since no page can render without a CMS in this job), memory is the server resident MB after 60 s idle.
